# Frozen invariants

1. No prose completion.
2. Workers never define success criteria.
3. No evidence, no PASS.
4. UNKNOWN never passes a hard gate.
5. No silent spec edits.
6. History is append-only.
7. Failure is data.
8. No fabricated evidence.
9. Exact duplicate knowledge must not inflate the dataset.
10. Negative facts are first-class.
11. Reuse before build.
12. Rights/license state is explicit; UNKNOWN rights never auto-REUSE.
13. Only missing delta becomes implementation work.
14. Technical completion is not economic validation.
15. External consequence requires authority declaration.
16. Every formula has id/version.
17. Every deterministic transformation binds input/output hashes.
18. Every derived fact names parent evidence/facts.
19. Every task maps to target requirement ids.
20. Every run reports observed cost/time/tokens or null; never secret estimates.
21. Every primitive is reusable outside the project that generated it.
22. Project-specific objects are composed from generic primitives where possible.
23. Canonical JSON is source of truth; markdown is only a projection.
